boundary_atlas.class_group_bridge: no narrow-class bijection is required or claimed by the theorem contract
boundary_atlas.imprimitive: dropping gcd(A,B,C)=1 duplicates lower primitive discriminants and changes the frozen phase space
boundary_atlas.invalid_congruence: integers congruent to 2 or 3 modulo 4 are not discriminants of integral binary quadratic forms
boundary_atlas.negative: Delta<0 is the definite or imaginary-quadratic regime and has no ordered real conjugate chart
boundary_atlas.norm_sign: an odd period matrix has determinant minus one; the determinant-plus-one stabilizer is then generated by its square
boundary_atlas.square: when Delta is a positive square, rational continued fractions terminate and the reduced irrational permutation theorem does not apply
boundary_atlas.zero: Delta=0 gives a repeated rational root and no real quadratic reduced phase space

collision_boundary.C16: the S-arithmetic rank-two clock uses continued fractions near walls but does not own fixed-discriminant reduced-state cycles
collision_boundary.C193: Markoff--Vieta dynamics is a terminating descent tree rather than a finite Gauss permutation
collision_boundary.C330: Romik dynamics uses a three-branch Pythagorean map rather than the complete reduced-form phase space at one discriminant

model.discriminant_chamber: Delta>0, Delta nonsquare, Delta congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 4
model.koopman: U f=f composed with G on l2 of the finite reduced-state set with counting measure
model.state: alpha=(P+sqrt(Delta))/Q with Q=2A>0, P=-B, C=(P^2-Delta)/(2Q), gcd(A,B,C)=1, alpha>1, and -1<alpha_conjugate<0

nonclaims: No priority claim is made for Gauss reduction, Lagrange periodicity, form stabilizers, or real-quadratic arithmetic.
The theorem is source-local and does not identify cycles with rational primes or prime powers.
The finite cycle product is not a target Euler product, target divisor, or completed arithmetic determinant.
The finite Koopman permutation is not a Hilbert--Polya operator or a target-zero realization.
No target arithmetic local data, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, functional equation, target-zero match, or Route-B input is claimed.

theorem_contract.cycle_stabilizer: each orbit has a primitive digit word; its positive digit-matrix product fixes the seed, has determinant (-1)^ell, and generates the positive cyclic stabilizer up to the norm-sign convention
theorem_contract.determinant: det(I-zU)=product over cycles of (1-z^ell), the reciprocal of the finite source Artin--Mazur zeta
theorem_contract.finite_permutation: for every admissible Delta the primitive reduced state set is finite and G is a bijection
theorem_contract.fixed_counts: Fix(G^n) is the sum of cycle lengths over cycle lengths dividing n
theorem_contract.multiplier: if M=[[a,b],[c,d]] is the inverse-branch period matrix and lambda=c*alpha+d>1, then the Gauss-cycle multiplier has magnitude lambda^2
theorem_contract.reversal: R is an involution and R G R=G inverse, hence it pairs cycles with reversed digit words
